description: §22.12 / §22.5.2 (S458 review F-A) — a cell named after a prototype member (`constructor`) is a legal cell, and `meta.get("constructor")` inside a runtime `^{}` compiles clean. The runtime registries behind `meta.get` / `meta.set` / `meta.subscribe` are null-prototype objects read own-property only, so the read returns the cell's value (or the absence value), never the page's `Object` off a plain-object prototype. The compile-time refusal (member access to `constructor` on a VALUE) is a separate rule; a string-literal cell NAME is not a member access.
